incidents.name: Thena reward pool unprotected unstake
incidents.notes: The Thena reward pool's unstake(address,uint256,address,bool) accepts an arbitrary token and pool from any caller and transfers the balance out without checking the caller's stake, so a freshly deployed contract could call it and take the pool's BUSD.

sources.ref: onchain review: reward pool 0x39E29f4FB13AeC505EF32Ee6Ff7cc16e2225B11F created 2023-03-18T21:24:49Z by 0x564b06d31f2ae2745cae60be2ce4bf92477002c4, unrelated to attack sender 0x586094fcafb76c3d9a209c58301802ce243269b8; it is an EIP-1967 proxy with four Upgraded events, the last at 1679934660 (2023-03-27T16:31:00Z), about 65 minutes before the incident, which is the basis for the age. Loss verified onchain: the attacker netted 10,197.89 USDT.
